description: Concrete technical response with specific metrics, diagnosis, and tradeoffs

input.question: Can you walk through a production incident you diagnosed and resolved?
input.answer: In Q3 2025 on our checkout service, P99 latency jumped from 45ms to 1200ms. I analyzed thread dumps, identified connection pool exhaustion in HikariCP due to an unindexed query, added the composite index on (order_id, tenant_id), and adjusted max pool size from 20 to 50, bringing P99 back down to 38ms.
